articles.content: Two of NASA's four missions operating at Mars have suspended science operations after encountering separate technical issues in recent weeks. The missions affected by the outages — hopefully temporary — are NASA's Perseverance rover and Odyssey orbiter. Both are operating beyond their original design lifetimes. articles.content: If you give an agent a Slack token and a post_message tool, it will eventually post as you. Not because it is malicious. Because a tool that is available looks like the next step, including when the model is lost, including when a retrieved document told it to. I do not want a longer system prompt. I want the write to be impossible until something that is not the model approves it.
